title: OpenWorldLib: A Unified Codebase and Definition of Advanced World Models
task: Unified inference framework for world models
key_results: Standardized definition and categorization of world model capabilities; integrated framework enabling efficient model reuse
comments: Provides valuable infrastructure but is primarily a systems contribution without novel algorithmic or empirical breakthroughs.

title: MinerU2.5-Pro: Pushing the Limits of Data-Centric Document Parsing at Scale
task: Data-centric document parsing at scale
key_results: 95.69% on OmniDocBench v1.6 (+2.71pp over same-architecture baseline), 65.5M training samples via data engineering alone with fixed 1.2B architecture
comments: Demonstrates that training data quality and scale can outweigh architectural innovation; notable for achieving SOTA without model changes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Performance bottlenecks stem from training data deficiencies rather than architecture
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via SOTA results from data engineering alone

title: TriAttention: Efficient Long Reasoning with Trigonometric KV Compression
task: KV cache compression for extended reasoning
key_results: 2.5x throughput improvement or 10.7x KV memory reduction on AIME25 32K-token generation while matching full attention accuracy; baselines achieve only ~50% accuracy at same efficiency
comments: Novel trigonometric approach to understanding Q/K concentration is elegant; enables practical deployment of long-context reasoning on consumer hardware.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pre-RoPE Q/K vectors concentrate around fixed centers, determining distance preferences via trigonometric series
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; enables stable key importance estimation

title: AURA: Always-On Understanding and Real-Time Assistance via Video Streams
task: Real-time streaming video understanding and interaction
key_results: State-of-the-art on streaming benchmarks; 2 FPS real-time demo on two 80G GPUs with ASR/TTS integration
comments: Strong system for practical deployment; contributions span context management, training objectives, and inference optimization rather than novel reasoning approaches.

title: LIBERO-Para: A Diagnostic Benchmark and Metrics for Paraphrase Robustness in VLA Models
task: Paraphrase robustness evaluation for VLA models
key_results: 22-52pp performance degradation under paraphrasing across 0.6B-7.5B models; 80-96% of failures from planning-level trajectory divergence; PRIDE metric quantifies difficulty via semantic/syntactic factors
comments: Reveals critical gap in VLA semantic grounding; PRIDE metric provides fine-grained difficulty assessment beyond binary success.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Paraphrasing disrupts task identification more than execution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 80-96% of failures are trajectory divergence, not execution errors

title: SpatialEdit: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Image Spatial Editing
task: Fine-grained image spatial editing benchmark and model
key_results: SpatialEdit-16B outperforms prior methods on spatial manipulation; synthetic dataset SpatialEdit-500k provides precise ground-truth transformations; benchmark jointly measures perceptual plausibility and geometric fidelity
comments: Addresses data bottleneck for spatial editing through controllable synthesis; useful benchmark but incremental on architectural front.

title: FileGram: Grounding Agent Personalization in File-System Behavioral Traces
task: File-system grounded agent personalization and memory
key_results: FileGramBench shows SOTA memory systems remain challenged on profile reconstruction, trace disentanglement, persona drift; FileGramEngine generates 65.5M+ multimodal action sequences; bottom-up memory outperforms dialogue-based approaches
comments: Tackles real constraint of privacy/multimodal data collection via simulation; memory architecture design is pragmatic for co-workers.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bottom-up memory from atomic actions outperforms dialogue-summary-based approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via FileGramBench

title: Adam's Law: Textual Frequency Law on Large Language Models
task: Textual frequency optimization for LLM prompting and fine-tuning
key_results: Textual Frequency Law (TFL) framework effective on math reasoning, MT, commonsense reasoning, tool-calling; Curriculum Textual Frequency Training outperforms baselines
comments: Proposes underexplored dimension (sentence-level frequency); however, evaluation is limited to in-house dataset and lacks comparison with simpler baselines.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frequent textual expressions improve LLM performance for both prompting and fine-tuning
hypotheses.result: Supported by experiments on TFPD dataset

title: ClawArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Evolving Information Environments
task: Evaluating agents in evolving information environments
key_results: 64 scenarios, 1,879 evaluation rounds across 8 professional domains; model capability ranges 15.4%, framework design 9.2%; belief revision difficulty determined by update strategy not update frequency
comments: ClawArena captures real-world complexity (multi-source conflicts, dynamic updates, implicit personalization); fills important benchmark gap.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Belief revision difficulty depends on update design strategy rather than update presence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via scenario analysis

title: LightThinker++: From Reasoning Compression to Memory Management
task: Efficient reasoning via dynamic thought compression and memory management
key_results: LightThinker: 70% peak token reduction, 26% inference speedup; LightThinker++: 69.9% token reduction with +2.42% accuracy gain; agentic tasks: 60-70% footprint reduction over 80 rounds with 14.8% avg performance gain
comments: Practical solution to reasoning overhead; evolution from compression to explicit memory primitives is well-motivated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Static compression fails on complex reasoning; explicit memory primitives enable stable long-horizon tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LightThinker++ maintains stability beyond 80 rounds

title: Unifying Group-Relative and Self-Distillation Policy Optimization via Sample Routing
task: Unified on-policy RL framework combining reward-aligned and logit-level supervision
key_results: SRPO raises Qwen3-8B average by 3.4% over GRPO, 6.3% over SDPO on five benchmarks; achieves rapid early improvement of SDPO and long-horizon stability of GRPO; 17.2% compute cost reduction
comments: Sample routing elegantly unifies two complementary objectives; entropy-aware weighting addresses instability without ad-hoc hyperparameters.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SDPO's late-stage instability stems from distillation on correct samples and degrading teacher signal
hypotheses.result: Addressed via sample routing; SRPO stabilizes training

title: SkillX: Automatically Constructing Skill Knowledge Bases for Agents
task: Automated skill knowledge base construction for LLM agents
key_results: Three-tiered skill hierarchy (strategic plans, functional skills, atomic); transferable across AppWorld, BFCL-v3, τ²-Bench; improves weaker agent performance
comments: SkillX addresses inefficient agent learning via structured, hierarchical experience representation; practical framework for skill reuse.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hierarchical skill representation generalizes better than flat trajectory storage
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via transfer to weaker agents

title: Self-Execution Simulation Improves Coding Models
task: Code generation via self-execution simulation
key_results: Consistent improvements over standard reasoning on competitive programming benchmarks; execution simulation enables self-verification and iterative fixing
comments: Grounding code understanding in step-by-step execution is intuitive; method combines SFT, explanation grounding, and RL effectively.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Training on execution simulation improves code generation through self-verification
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via competitive programming benchmarks

title: Vero: An Open RL Recipe for General Visual Reasoning
task: Visual reasoning via open RL recipe across diverse tasks
key_results: Vero-600K achieves 3.7-5.5pp improvements over four base models; outperforms Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking on 23/30 benchmarks without proprietary thinking data; task-routed rewards handle heterogeneous formats
comments: Broad data coverage emerges as primary RL scaling driver; fully open recipe contrasts with proprietary baselines.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Different task categories elicit distinct reasoning patterns with poor isolation transfer
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; broad data coverage is primary scaling driver

title: Your Agent, Their Asset: A Real-World Safety Analysis of OpenClaw
task: Real-world safety evaluation of personal AI agents
key_results: 24.6% baseline attack success rate increases to 64-74% under single CIK dimension poisoning; strongest defense yields 63.8% under capability-targeted attacks; file protection blocks 97% malicious but prevents 100% legitimate updates
comments: First real-world OpenClaw evaluation on live instance; reveals architectural vulnerabilities inherent to broad system access.

model_io.model: OpenClaw (Claude Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.4)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vulnerabilities are architectural, not model-specific
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; threefold increase in baseline vulnerability across all models

title: PLUME: Latent Reasoning Based Universal Multimodal Embedding
task: Universal multimodal embedding with latent reasoning
key_results: PLUME outperforms explicit-CoT baselines on MMEB-v2 (78 tasks); reduces reasoning from hundreds of tokens to <10 latent steps; 30x faster inference
comments: Latent reasoning pathway elegantly avoids textual bottleneck; progressive explicit-to-latent curriculum is effective training strategy.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent reasoning preserves benefits of intermediate reasoning without explicit-CoT overhead
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 30x faster with better performance

title: Less Detail, Better Answers: Degradation-Driven Prompting for VQA
task: Visual Question Answering via strategic image degradation
key_results: Degradation-Driven Prompting improves VQA on physical attributes and perceptual phenomena; downsampling + structural aids force focus on essential information
comments: Counter-intuitive finding that less detail improves reasoning; effective use of prompt engineering and input degradation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-resolution details become noise; strategic degradation improves reasoning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on physical attributes and perceptual phenomena tasks

title: Memory Intelligence Agent
task: Memory-based deep research agents with parametric-nonparametric integration
key_results: Manager-Planner-Executor architecture with test-time learning; bidirectional conversion between parametric and non-parametric memory; improvements across eleven benchmarks
comments: Memory Intelligence Agent framework integrates multiple mechanisms (alternating RL, test-time learning, reflection); strong empirical results but contributions are engineering-heavy.

title: Learning to Learn-at-Test-Time: Language Agents with Learnable Adaptation Policies
task: Learning optimal adaptation policies for test-time language agents
key_results: Meta-TTL outperforms hand-crafted baselines on Jericho and WebArena-Lite in both ID and OOD settings; formulates adaptation policy discovery as bi-level optimization
comments: Shifts from engineering to learning adaptation policies; evolutionary search over task distribution provides principled approach.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learned adaptation policies generalize better than hand-crafted ones
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across ID and OOD settings

title: CLEAR: Unlocking Generative Potential for Degraded Image Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
task: Degraded image understanding via generative-reasoning integration
key_results: CLEAR substantially improves robustness on degraded inputs while preserving clean performance; Latent Representation Bridge enables direct optimization; intermediate visual states have higher perceptual quality than pixel-level reconstruction
comments: Clever use of generative pathway for degradation robustness; Interleaved GRPO jointly optimizes text and visual generation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Generative capacity can model fine-grained structure lost to degradation; task-driven optimization aligns with visual quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CLEAR improves robustness and perceptual quality

title: Can LLMs Learn to Reason Robustly under Noisy Supervision?
task: Robust reasoning under noisy labels in RLVR
key_results: Online Label Refinement (OLR) improves robustness by 3.6-3.9% on in-distribution, 3.3-4.6% on out-of-distribution under noise ratios 0.1-0.9; identifies Early Correctness Coherence phenomenon
comments: Systematic analysis of noise in RLVR distinguishes inactive vs. active noise; progressive label correction is pragmatic.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rollout-based RLVR naturally extends to noisy labels; inactive noise reduces efficiency, active noise skews distribution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; OLR corrects through majority voting and consistency

title: AvatarPointillist: AutoRegressive 4D Gaussian Avatarization
task: 4D Gaussian avatar generation from single portrait
key_results: AvatarPointillist generates photorealistic, controllable avatars; autoregressive point generation with adaptive density; joint prediction of binding information enables realistic animation
comments: Novel autoregressive formulation for avatar generation; decoder-only transformer sequentially constructs Gaussian splatting points.

title: HDP: A Lightweight Cryptographic Protocol for Human Delegation Provenance in Agentic AI Systems
task: Cryptographic protocol for human delegation provenance in agentic AI
key_results: HDP token binds authorization to session, records append-only delegation chain, enables offline verification via Ed25519; published as IETF Internet-Draft; addresses multi-hop human-provenance gap
comments: Systems contribution addressing accountability in multi-agent delegation; lightweight design without registry lookups.

title: SciLT: Long-Tailed Classification in Scientific Image Domains
task: Long-tailed classification in scientific image domains
key_results: SciLT exploits multi-level representations via adaptive fusion; balanced performance across head/tail classes on three scientific benchmarks; outperforms existing methods with parameter-efficient fine-tuning
comments: Addresses domain gap between natural and scientific images; penultimate-layer features critical for tail class performance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Penultimate-layer features critical for tail classes under domain shift
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; dual-supervision on multiple levels improves balance

title: Paper Espresso: From Paper Overload to Research Insight
task: Automated discovery, summarization, and trend analysis of arXiv papers
key_results: Paper Espresso processed 13,300+ papers over 35 months; revealed mid-2025 RL surge, 6,673 unique topics, 2.0x upvote correlation with novelty; multi-granularity trend analysis
comments: Infrastructure for research landscape monitoring; demonstrates value of LLM-driven paper analysis at scale.

title: The Geometric Alignment Tax: Tokenization vs. Continuous Geometry in Scientific Foundation Models
task: Evaluating geometric fidelity of foundation models for biology/physics
key_results: Geometric Alignment Tax: 8.5x distortion reduction from discrete to continuous heads; learned codebooks exhibit non-monotonic double bind; 14 biological models show 3 failure regimes (Local-Global Decoupling, Representational Compression, Geometric Vacuity)
comments: Reveals fundamental tension between discrete tokenization and continuous geometry; rate-distortion analysis is rigorous.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Discrete categorical bottleneck systematically fails to preserve continuous system geometry
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; continuous heads achieve 8.5x lower distortion

title: POEMetric: The Last Stanza of Humanity
task: Comprehensive poetry evaluation framework
key_results: POEMetric assesses 30 LLMs on 6,090 poems vs. 203 human poems; top model: form accuracy 4.26/5, theme 4.99; humans exceed on creativity (4.02), idiosyncrasy (3.95), emotional resonance (4.06), imagery (4.49), devices (4.67); overall poem quality humans 4.22 vs. LLM 3.20
comments: First comprehensive poetry evaluation; humans remain superior on advanced literary capabilities despite strong form/theme performance by LLMs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs can follow form/theme instructions but fail on creativity and emotional resonance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; all models lag on advanced abilities

title: Hypoxia-induced XBP1s-MYDGF axis suppresses ferroptosis through UBQLN1-mediated stabilization of LCN2 in gastric cancer
task: Define hypoxia-induced XBP1s-MYDGF axis suppression of ferroptosis in gastric cancer
key_results: Hypoxia activates XBP1 splicing to promote MYDGF expression; MYDGF competes with UBQLN1 at STI1-4 domain, blocking ERAD of LCN2; stabilized LCN2 sequesters iron and inhibits ferroptosis; disruption of axis sensitizes cells to ferroptosis inducers in vitro and in vivo
comments: Elegant mechanistic axis linking hypoxia to ferroptosis evasion; structural detail on MYDGF-UBQLN1 binding warrants crystallographic validation; therapeutic potential in hypoxic tumors is compelling.

outputs: Increased ferroptosis sensitivity in vitro and in vivo

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hypoxia-induced XBP1s-MYDGF axis antagonizes ferroptosis via LCN2 stabilization
hypotheses.result: Genetic disruption of axis sensitizes gastric cancer cells to ferroptosis inducers both in vitro and in vivo; MYDGF blocks UBQLN1-mediated LCN2 ERAD

title: NSUN2/ALYREF-mediated RNA m5c modification promotes anoikis resistance of prostate cancer through activating autophagy
task: Delineate NSUN2/ALYREF m5C modification in prostate cancer anoikis resistance
key_results: ALYREF knockdown reduces prostate cancer proliferation, invasion, and metastasis; ALYREF recognizes m5C on BNIP3 mRNA, enhancing stability; BNIP3 activation promotes autophagy and anoikis resistance
comments: Clear mechanistic pathway linking m5C recognition to autophagy; direct binding validation and ALYREF-BNIP3 competition assays would strengthen causation claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ALYREF-mediated m5C recognition of BNIP3 mRNA activates autophagy and promotes anoikis resistance
hypotheses.result: ALYREF knockdown reduces BNIP3 mRNA stability and autophagy; ALYREF enhances BNIP3 mRNA stability and anoikis resistance

title: The E3 ubiquitin ligase HUWE1 is required for KRAS-induced lung cancer
task: Establish HUWE1 requirement for KRAS-driven lung adenocarcinoma
key_results: HUWE1 upregulation correlates with LUAD stage; Huwe1 essential for Kras-induced tumor development; HUWE1 depletion induces senescence via p53-independent mechanism
comments: Strong in vivo validation across multiple models; mechanistic role in SASP/NFκB signaling is demonstrated but substrate specificity in senescence induction remains partially unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: HUWE1 is essential for mutant Kras-induced lung tumorigenesis
hypotheses.result: Huwe1 depletion induces senescence and blocks tumor development in p53-independent manner

title: SIRT1 mediates KU70 to maintain genomic stability in spermatogonial stem cells via the NHEJ repair pathway
task: Elucidate SIRT1-KU70 axis in spermatogonial stem cell DNA damage response
key_results: Reduced SIRT1 expression in NOA patient SSCs correlates with attenuated NHEJ signatures; SIRT1 deacetylates KU70 to enhance NHEJ repair efficiency; SIRT1 overexpression reduces KU70 acetylation and supports SSC proliferation under genotoxic stress
comments: Comprehensive in vivo and in vitro validation with clinical samples; mechanistic detail on KU70 acetylation is well-supported but acetylation sites and broader KU70 functions merit deeper analysis.

model_io.model: Human testicular tissue (NOA patients vs. controls)
In vivo/in vitro DNA damage models (X-ray, hydroxyurea)

hypotheses.hypothesis: SIRT1 maintains SSC homeostasis by deacetylating KU70 to enhance NHEJ-mediated DNA repair
hypotheses.result: SIRT1 knockdown reduces NHEJ repair; SIRT1 overexpression decreases KU70 acetylation and promotes SSC survival under genotoxic stress

title: PHIP suppresses NuRD to enable the growth of SWI/SNF-mutant cancers
task: Identify chromatin-based vulnerabilities in SWI/SNF-mutant cancers
key_results: PHIP is a dependency in SWI/SNF-disrupted cancers; PHIP ubiquitinates NuRD complex subunits to antagonize repressive activity; SWI/SNF loss causes NuRD accumulation at promoters requiring PHIP for transcriptional activation
comments: Robust CRISPR screening and mechanistic elegance; direct PHIP-NuRD interaction topology and substrate specificity merit structural characterization.

model_io.model: Genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 screening in cancer cell lines
outputs: PHIP identified as dependency in SWI/SNF-disrupted cancers

hypotheses.hypothesis: PHIP antagonizes NuRD repression to enable SWI/SNF-mutant cancer growth
hypotheses.result: PHIP ubiquitinates NuRD subunits; loss of SWI/SNF causes NuRD accumulation at promoters; PHIP suppression of NuRD is required for transcriptional activation

title: Single-oocyte full-length isoform sequencing unveils the impact of transposable elements on RNA diversity and stability
task: Map isoform diversity in oocytes during maturation
key_results: 7154 novel human and 4875 novel mouse isoforms identified; ~30% of novel isoforms derived from transposable elements; ARHGAP18 novel isoforms enhance stability and affect microtubule localization
comments: Valuable resource but functional validation limited to one gene; transposable element contribution to isoform stability is mechanistically under-explored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transposable elements incorporated in transcripts enhance isoform stability
hypotheses.result: ~30% of NNC isoforms contain transposable elements; enhanced stability during oocyte maturation

title: Identification of stem cell marker-positive subpopulations in the vocal fold of the larynx through transcriptomic analyses
task: Characterize cellular composition and stem cell populations in laryngeal mucosa
key_results: Identified SOX9-positive and Lgr5-positive stem cell subpopulations in vocal fold; generated three types of epithelial organoids; revealed supraglottis/subglottis pseudostratified columnar epithelium differences
comments: Useful transcriptomic and spatial resource; limited functional characterization of stem cell populations and organoid-derived tissues.

model_io.model: Single-cell RNA-sequencing and spatial transcriptomics (mouse laryngeal mucosa)

title: ASO therapy rescues NOTCH2NLC GGC repeat expansion-induced genomic damage, 3D chromatin structural abnormalities, and senescence
task: Define pathogenic mechanisms and ASO therapy for NOTCH2NLC GGC repeat expansion disease
key_results: PolyG aggregates disrupt nucleolar homeostasis and chromatin organization via CTCF/RAD21 downregulation; ASO treatment reduces aggregates and alleviates senescence (brain organoids from patient samples)
comments: Comprehensive mechanistic study; proof-of-concept ASO efficacy in organoids is promising but requires in vivo validation.

model_io.model: Patient-derived brain organoids (neuronal intranuclear inclusion disease)

hypotheses.hypothesis: PolyG aggregates disrupt chromatin organization via nucleophosmin mislocalization and CTCF/RAD21 downregulation
hypotheses.result: CTCF/RAD21 restoration mitigates chromatin structural defects; ASO reduces aggregates and ameliorates senescence

title: Silver nanoparticles combine with Nigella sativa oil to potentiate apoptosis in cervical cancer
task: Investigate synergistic apoptotic effects of Nigella sativa oil and silver nanoparticles in cervical cancer
key_results: Combination of 5 µg/mL AgNPs + 150 µg/mL NS induced 29.1% early apoptosis; pro-apoptotic genes (BAX, BAK, p53, caspase-9) upregulated 3.2–4.8-fold; BCL-2 suppressed (0.28-fold)
comments: Clear synergistic apoptotic induction in vitro; mechanistic characterization of complementary pathways (oxidative stress vs. epigenetic modulation) is limited; in vivo validation essential.

outputs: Gene expression (BAX, BAK, p53, caspase-9, BCL-2)

hypotheses.hypothesis: AgNPs and NS combination amplifies apoptosis through complementary mechanisms (oxidative stress and epigenetic modulation)
hypotheses.result: Combination treatment induces 29.1% early apoptosis with 3.2–4.8-fold upregulation of pro-apoptotic genes and 0.28-fold suppression of BCL-2

title: Montelukast attenuates diclofenac sodium-induced cardiotoxicity in male rats via targeting Wnt/β-catenin pathway
task: Investigate cardioprotective mechanism of montelukast against diclofenac-induced cardiotoxicity via Wnt/β-catenin pathway
key_results: DCFN treatment upregulates Wnt-1, active β-catenin, and FZD-1; increases cardiac biomarkers, oxidative stress, and apoptosis; montelukast co-treatment significantly attenuates all pathological alterations and oxidative stress markers
comments: Clear pathway mechanistic link and histological validation; direct evidence for Wnt/β-catenin causation in DCFN cardiotoxicity could be strengthened via Wnt pathway inhibitors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: DCFN cardiotoxicity involves Wnt/β-catenin pathway upregulation
hypotheses.result: DCFN increases Wnt-1, active β-catenin, and FZD-1 expression; montelukast attenuates pathway activation and cardiac injury

title: 4-Phenylbutyrate mitigates renal pathology linked to ER stress related pathways in C57BL/6J mice with hindlimb unloading
task: Assess 4-phenylbutyrate efficacy in mitigating hindlimb unloading-induced renal ER stress
key_results: Hindlimb unloading induces ER stress-associated protein dysregulation and renal pathology; 4-PBA partially attenuates alterations; GO/KEGG/Reactome analyses confirm modulation of ER stress and cytoprotective pathways
comments: First transcriptomic characterization of HU-induced renal changes; mechanistic depth limited—specific ER stress effectors and downstream signaling nodes warrant investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: 4-PBA mitigates HU-induced renal pathology by reducing ER stress
hypotheses.result: 4-PBA treatment partially attenuates ER stress-associated protein dysregulation and renal alterations; GO/KEGG analyses confirm pathway modulation

title: Inhibition of CDK9 sensitizes multidrug resistant ovarian cancer cells to paclitaxel
task: Determine CDK9 role in multidrug resistance of ovarian cancer
key_results: CDK9 elevated in drug-resistant ovarian cancer cells; CDK9 inhibition enhances paclitaxel sensitivity and apoptosis; reduced Pol II and Stat3 phosphorylation; decreased spheroid formation and motility
comments: Clear functional evidence linking CDK9 to drug resistance; mechanism via Stat3 warrants further investigation for direct vs. indirect effects.

hypotheses.hypothesis: CDK9 inhibition enhances paclitaxel sensitivity in drug-resistant ovarian cancer
hypotheses.result: CDK9 inhibition increases apoptosis and reduces Pol II/Stat3 phosphorylation; decreased spheroid formation

title: Spastin-mediated severing of glutamylated microtubules controls cardiomyocyte coupling
task: Define spastin-mediated microtubule remodeling in cardiac electrical stability
key_results: Ischemia-reperfusion promotes glutamylated, stabilized microtubules via spastin; spastin deficiency impairs Cx43 trafficking and increases arrhythmia susceptibility; microtubule glutamylation inhibition preserves Cx43 localization and mitigates ischemia-reperfusion injury
comments: Novel link between microtubule glutamylation and cardiac arrhythmia; spastin's role in stress response is well-demonstrated but substrate specificity beyond microtubule severing could be explored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Microtubule glutamylation impairs Cx43 trafficking and increases arrhythmia susceptibility
hypotheses.result: Spastin deficiency causes glutamylated microtubule accumulation and impaired Cx43 transport; glutamylation inhibition preserves Cx43 and prevents stress-induced arrhythmias

title: Pushing the limits of fluorescence imaging with a restoration neural network aggregating large-view statistics
task: Large-patch restoration neural network for fluorescence imaging under photon-limited conditions
key_results: LargePNet achieved 0.5-2 dB higher PSNR vs. state-of-the-art; 4-fold and 20-fold efficiency gains over convolution and Transformer networks; enabled 30-hour cytoskeleton and hour-long tri-color super-resolution imaging
comments: Architectural innovation leveraging large receptive fields is well-motivated; practical demonstration of extended live-cell imaging is compelling, though computational requirements scale with image size.

model_io.model: LargePNet combining ultra-large-kernel shallow convolutions with deep nonlinear representations via scale separation
inputs: single-image, video, or volumetric fluorescence data under photon-limited conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Large-patch training with global view statistics improves noise-resistance and fidelity over small-patch networks
hypotheses.result: LargePNet achieved 0.5-2 dB PSNR improvement; 4-20x efficiency gains; enabled extended live-cell imaging

title: Quantitative susceptibility mapping and MRS-based multimodal machine learning for early Parkinson’s disease classification
task: Multimodal machine learning for early Parkinson's disease classification using QSM and MRS
key_results: XGBoost model achieved AUC 0.984 (training) and 0.973 (test); identified key diagnostic biomarkers via SHAP analysis
comments: Strong predictive performance and interpretability via SHAP, though multicenter cohort composition and feature generalization across sites warrant detailed reporting.

model_io.model: Ensemble of Random Forest, SVM, XGBoost, and Light GBM classifiers with SHAP interpretation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integration of neurochemical metabolites and QSM radiomics improves early PD detection
hypotheses.result: XGBoost achieved AUC 0.984/0.973; identified neurobiological biomarkers underlying early PD pathology

title: A foundation generative model for breast ultrasound image analysis
task: Foundation generative model for breast ultrasound image analysis and cancer detection
key_results: Outperformed 9 board-certified radiologists with 16.5% sensitivity improvement (P<0.0001); exceeded real-data-trained models in screening, diagnosis, and prognosis tasks
comments: Pretraining on 3.5M images demonstrates scalability, though clinical validation across diverse populations remains important for deployment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Few-shot adaptation enables generation of realistic synthetic data for downstream tasks
hypotheses.result: Synthetic data significantly exceeded real-data-trained models; characterized scaling effects of synthetic data

title: A finely annotated dataset for the automated acoustic identification of European Orthoptera and Cicadidae
task: Develop annotated acoustic dataset for automated identification of European orthopterans and cicadas
key_results: 11,224 recordings covering 193 orthopteran and 24 cicada species; combines weak labeling (coarse) with strong labeling (fine annotation of time/frequency ranges)
comments: Comprehensive European-focused dataset addresses regional monitoring gaps, though ecological heterogeneity and annotation consistency across curators should be characterized.

model_io.model: Passive acoustic monitoring infrastructure and annotation pipeline

title: Adults’ dental cone beam computed tomography images dataset for detecting and classifying missing teeth
task: CBCT dataset with 3D annotations for automated detection and classification of missing teeth in implant planning
key_results: 158 CBCT volumes with 501 missing tooth sites; 85 volumes with 114 sites containing 4,994 annotated slices; established baselines via clinical evaluation and deep learning modeling
comments: Curated multi-institutional dataset addresses annotation scarcity, though modest size (158 subjects) and institution-specific imaging protocols may limit generalization.

model_io.model: Deep learning baselines trained on 3D-annotated CBCT volumes for missing tooth detection
inputs: 3D Slicer annotations of 501 missing tooth sites with artifact characterization

title: Desidustat’s cardioprotective mechanisms in heart failure: a network pharmacology, molecular docking and dynamics approach
task: Identify cardioprotective mechanisms of desidustat in heart failure via network pharmacology
key_results: 348 shared drug-disease targets identified; HSP90AA1 prioritized as key hub with strongest binding (ΔGbind = -75.10 ± 5.03 kcal/mol); 200-ns MD simulations confirmed structural stability
comments: In silico hypothesis-generation study with strong computational support, but requires experimental validation of predicted HSP90AA1-mediated cardioprotection.

model_io.model: Integrated network pharmacology, molecular docking, and MD simulation pipeline

hypotheses.hypothesis: Desidustat exerts cardioprotection via polypharmacological modulation of metabolic and inflammatory pathways through HSP90AA1
hypotheses.result: HSP90AA1-desidustat complex showed exceptional structural stability and strong binding free energy; functional enrichment linked targets to oxidative stress response and apoptosis regulation

title: Mitigating label noise in network intrusion detection via graph-based sample selection and purification
task: Data-centric relabeling framework to mitigate label noise in network intrusion detection
key_results: SilentSentinel achieved F1 0.81 (CIC-IDS2017) and 0.98 (DoHBrw-2020) under 40% label noise; 17.39% and 11.36% relative improvements vs. state-of-the-art baselines
comments: Two-stage framework (graph propagation + dual-network screening) is well-motivated for noisy security datasets; robustness to different noise mechanisms should be further explored.

model_io.model: SilentSentinel: Normal Sample Discovery (graph propagation) + Malicious Sample Screening (dual networks)
inputs: network intrusion traffic with label noise

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graph-based sample selection and dual-network purification reduce label noise and stabilize training in intrusion detection
hypotheses.result: SilentSentinel achieved F1 0.81/0.98 under 40% noise; 17.39%/11.36% relative improvements vs. baselines

title: Federated multi-label text feature selection via manifold-aware sparse modeling and cooperative grey wolf optimization
task: Federated multi-label text feature selection via manifold-aware sparse modeling and cooperative optimization
key_results: Fed-MSMCGWO consistently surpassed centralized and federated baselines on multi-label text datasets; preserved privacy via parameter-only aggregation without raw data sharing
comments: Privacy-preserving federated approach is valuable for distributed text classification, though specific datasets, baselines, and evaluation metrics are not detailed in abstract.

model_io.model: Fed-MSMCGWO: two-stage optimization (manifold-aware sparse modeling + cooperative grey wolf optimization) with privacy-preserving parameter aggregation
inputs: distributed multi-label text data across clients

hypotheses.hypothesis: Federated manifold-aware sparse modeling with cooperative optimization enables effective multi-label text feature selection without raw data sharing
hypotheses.result: Fed-MSMCGWO surpassed standard centralized and federated baselines across evaluation metrics while preserving privacy

title: The future of power forecasting: neuromorphic-axolotl hybrid intelligence revolutionizing grid operations through bio-inspired missing data mastery
